mechanism_narrative: A 3-month cumulative decline in FEDFUNDS signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing expected equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals tightening policy, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS above 150,000 for 2 consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in PAYEMS below 120,000 for 3 consecutive months signals weakening labor demand, which compresses earnings expectations and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month cumulative decline in GDPC1 below 20000 indicates softening aggregate demand, which compresses corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in softening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO below 100 for 2 consecutive months signals tight supply conditions, which boosts commodity and resource valuations and supports equity risk premia, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in tight supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in INDPRO above 110 for 3 consecutive months signals abundant supply, which compresses commodity and resource valuations and reduces equity risk premia, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in abundant supply periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month cumulative decline in CPIAUCSL below 280 signals a shift to deflationary expectations, which compresses discount rates and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
